question: How many days of annual leave do full-time employees accrue per year?
expected_answer: Full-time employees accrue 1.75 days per month, for a total of 21 days per calendar year.

question: How many unused annual leave days can I carry over into next year?
expected_answer: You may carry over a maximum of 5 unused annual leave days into the next calendar year.

question: How much advance notice do I need to give before requesting annual leave?
expected_answer: Leave must be requested at least 5 business days in advance through the HR portal.

question: If I have more than 5 unused leave days at the end of the year, what happens to the extra days?
expected_answer: Any unused days beyond the 5-day cap are forfeited on December 31st unless the employee has an approved carryover exception on file with HR.

question: How many paid sick days do employees get per calendar year?
expected_answer: Employees receive 10 paid sick days per calendar year.

question: Do I need to provide a doctor's note if I'm out sick?
expected_answer: Only for absences exceeding 3 consecutive business days -- you must submit a doctor's note to HR within 5 business days of returning to work.

question: Does unused sick leave carry over into the next calendar year?
expected_answer: No, sick leave does not carry over between calendar years.

question: How many weeks of paid parental leave do eligible employees receive?
expected_answer: Eligible employees receive 12 weeks of paid parental leave following the birth or adoption of a child.

question: How long do I need to have worked here to qualify for paid parental leave?
expected_answer: You must have completed at least 6 months of continuous employment to be eligible for paid parental leave.

question: I've only worked here for 3 months -- what parental leave am I entitled to?
expected_answer: Employees below the 6-month tenure threshold are eligible for unpaid leave under applicable local law, not paid parental leave.

question: What is the minimum password length required for company accounts?
expected_answer: Passwords must be at least 14 characters long and include a mix of uppercase, lowercase, numeric, and special characters.

question: How often do I need to rotate my password on a high-sensitivity system?
expected_answer: Passwords for high-sensitivity systems must be rotated every 90 days.

question: What's the password rotation requirement for standard-sensitivity systems?
expected_answer: Standard-sensitivity systems require password rotation every 180 days.

question: Can I reuse a password I used a few rotations ago?
expected_answer: No, reused passwords from the last 10 rotations are not permitted.

question: What security features must be enabled on my company-issued laptop?
expected_answer: Disk encryption, a screen lock, and endpoint monitoring software must be enabled at all times.

question: How quickly must I report a lost or stolen company device?
expected_answer: Within 1 hour of discovery, so it can be remotely wiped and access revoked.

question: Who needs to approve a request for access beyond my default role?
